❑ Overall Inflation rate remained
fairly stable in 2Q 2020 at 5.3% on
average compared to 5.9% in a
similar period last year.
❑ The rate of inflation consistently fell
during the quarter from 6% in April
to 4.6% in June and 4.4% in July.
❑ Overall inflation is expected to
remain within the range of 4% to
6%, largely due to lower
international oil prices, lower VAT
rate, favorable weather for
agriculture and muted demand
pressure.
